R0275.title: Robot Middleware (ROS/DDS) Vulnerability Exploitation
R0275.definition: Exploitation of known vulnerabilities and default-insecure configurations (no authentication, plaintext multicast) of the Robot Operating System (ROS/ROS2), DDS middleware, and MoveIt motion-planning library to achieve node takeover, topic injection, or command tampering.
R0275.description:
Robot middleware vulnerability exploitation targets the security defects of ROS/ROS2, the de-facto standard middleware. eProsima FastDDS (ROS2 default DDS) disclosed a heap buffer overflow in 2024 (CVE-2024-30259); a publisher sending a malformed RTPS packet can remotely crash subscribers. The ROS-CVE-CNVDs project collects 33 buffer-overflow/use-after-free vulnerabilities in ROS2 Nav2 components. SROS2/DDS-Security is not enabled by default, and only 3 of the 5 security SPIs are implemented; cross-vendor DDS does not support secure communication. The DDS Discovery protocol can enumerate all ROS2 applications' domain IDs/topics/services on a LAN. The rostopic CLI tool has eval() code-injection vulnerabilities (CVE-2024-41921/41148). ROS's default no-authentication design makes lateral movement within a network extremely low-barrier.

This risk relates to R0165 (IoT botnet) and R0213 (edge-compute node attack), but is specialized for the robot-middleware ecosystem, a severe area for ROS2 deployments.
R0275.influence: Causes entire robot-system takeover, multi-node coordination disruption, and tampering of safety-critical commands; ROS's default no-authentication design makes intra-network lateral movement extremely low-barrier, capable of paralyzing an entire robot fleet or swarm.

observables: ROS2 inter-node communication does not enable SROS2/DDS-Security authentication
Middleware such as FastDDS shows malformed RTPS packets causing remote crashes
DDS Discovery protocol enumerates all ROS2 application domains in the LAN
Tools such as rostopic have eval code-injection vulnerabilities that are exploited
After takeover, multi-node coordination is disrupted or commands are tampered with
